name: Globloom
subtitle: Fuse orbs, tame the tide
shortDescription: Slide, aim and drop sea-glass orbs into a golden globe; twins fuse into bigger ones while ten worlds bend the rules with pegs, tides and urchins.
longDescription:
A golden-rimmed globe floats above a sunlit lagoon. Slide to aim, lift your finger to let a glass orb fall, and watch twins of the same size fuse into the next size up. Grow the goal orb before the drops run out and before the pile creeps over the tide mark.

### Ten Worlds, Ten Twists
Sunny Shallows teaches the fusing. Pearl Pegs scatters pearls that orbs bounce off. Tidal Tilt rocks the whole sea so the pile slides. Urchin Reef sends spiky urchins that pop everything beside them. Frost Cove brings frosted orbs that stay inert until a nearby fusion thaws them. Prism Bay hands you prisms that lift any orb one size. Whirlpool turns a current through the water, Magnet Shoal pulls orbs toward a pink pearl, Rising Tide lowers the tide mark with every drop, and Grand Lagoon stacks the lot. That makes 100 levels, each with three stars to chase.

### Daily Tide And Deep Dive
The Daily Tide serves the same twisted globe to everyone on that date and keeps a streak. Deep Dive is the calm alternative: no goal, no budget, just stacking and fusing for the highest score you can reach.

### Small Helps, Free Charms
Swap the orb in your hand with the next one. If the globe overflows, an optional video can pop the seven smallest orbs, or give three extra drops when you run out. Levels, Dailies and Deep Dive pay out free coins that buy 24 collectible charms, from the Sun Disc to the Grand Pearl, to wear as a gem on the rim. Fixed prices, no random draws.

Daylight lagoons, glossy 3D glass and soft chimes you can switch off. Works offline.
